Shell(node --input-type=module -e  import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"; import * as sass from "sass"; const { css } = sass.compile("src/lib/styles/index.sass", { style: "expanded" }); const bundle = new Set(); for (const raw of css.split("\n")) { const line = raw.trim(); if (line.startsWith("@")) continue; const m = /^(.*)\{\s*$/.exec(line); if (!m) continue; for (const c of m[1].matchAll(/\.(-?[_a-zA-Z][\w-]*)/g)) bundle.add("." + c[1]); } const reg = JSON.parse(readFileSync("src/lib/data/registry.json", "utf8")); const regset = new Set(reg.layers.flatMap((l) => l.items.filter((i) => i.kind === "class").map((i) => i.name))); const onlyReg = [...regset].filter((n) => !bundle.has(n)); const onlyBundle = [...bundle].filter((n) => !regset.has(n)); console.log("bundle unique classes:", bundle.size, "| registry:", regset.size); console.log("registry-only:", onlyReg.length, onlyReg.slice(0, 8)); console.log("bundle-only:", onlyBundle.length, onlyBundle.slice(0, 8)); console.log("elements:", reg.layers.flatMap((l) => l.items.filter((i) => i.kind === "element").map((i) => i.name)).join(" ")); )
